flow.name: axn-term - remote sign-in: real app device flow + authority publish
flow.description: End-to-end through the REAL desktop app: the axn-term adapter launches the built binary with a temp state dir, seeds remote settings into its config.yaml, triggers remoteAuth.signIn() via the remote-control server (the same code path the "Sign in…" button runs — plugin_exec → curl), then Playwright approves the device grant in a real browser, and the app must reach signedIn. This is the faithful reproduction of the invalid_client regression — remote-auth.ts stubs the client, this drives it. Plain listeners: keycloak :18096, gateway :18095 (127.0.0.1 — app runs on the same host as the scenario).

step.description: Seed remote settings into the run's config.yaml
Trigger signIn() in-app; device POST must reach pending (the invalid_client repro)

assert.description: Device endpoint accepted the app's client_id

step.description: Headless Chromium approves the device grant
App polls the token endpoint and lands signedIn
